summary: Iteration 7 — verified the two new backend features end-to-end: (1) Real fillable AcroForm PDFs for client/caregiver onboarding via /app/backend/forms.py + /api/documents/rebuild-fillable, and (2) Policy acknowledgment endpoints (POST/GET/DELETE /api/policies/acknowledge*). Created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7_fillable_and_policies.py with 25 focused tests — ALL 25 PASS. Confirmed contracts: GET /api/documents?category=client_onboarding returns exactly 13 unique docs (seq 1-13, all with file_base64); GET /api/documents?category=caregiver_onboarding returns exactly 14 unique docs (seq 1-14), each one a real fillable PDF >5KB with /AcroForm + /T ( field markers. Verified rebuild-fillable returns {updated: 19, deleted_duplicates: N} and is idempotent (second call → deleted_duplicates=0). Verified caregiver/admin policy ack flow: upsert is idempotent (single row per (policy_id, user_id)), caregivers only see their own acks, admins can ?user_id=X to view caregiver acks, DELETE removes the ack. Regression smoke: login, /api/shifts, /api/ms/status, /api/reports/audit-binder, /api/reports/replication-playbook.pdf, /api/reports/replication-intake-form.pdf, /api/chat/threads, /api/assignments, /api/documents/{id}/push — all green. Full repo regression: 95/99 PASS; the 4 remaining failures are all pre-existing drift documented in iter-2/iter-6 reports (3 iter-2 seed-templates count drift, 1 iter-5 ms-export-now detail-string change) — the review request explicitly says these are OK to ignore.

critical_code_review_comments: forms.py is a clean, single-responsibility module (~810 lines, mostly form-builder data). Each builder calls _wrap → reportlab Canvas with c.acroForm.* widgets, so all generated PDFs are real fillable AcroForm PDFs (verified by byte inspection: /AcroForm + /T ( markers present in every PDF).
Generated PDF sizes range ~6-12 KB each, well above the >5KB threshold — confirms reportlab AcroForm structure (not just static text).
rebuild_fillable correctly uses Mongo $set for upsert-by-(category,title,is_template=True) and the dedupe pass is keyed on stripped canonical title → idempotent on second call. ✓
/api/policies/acknowledge uses Mongo update_one with upsert=True keyed on (policy_id, user_id) → idempotent by construction. ✓
/api/policies/acknowledgments RBAC correct: caregiver branch forces q['user_id']=current.id, ignoring any client-supplied user_id query param. Admin branch honors ?user_id=X. ✓
Pydantic input validation (PolicyAckReq) is in place; 404 returned when policy_id doesn't exist or category != 'policy'. ✓

Minor — db.policy_acks has no explicit unique index on (policy_id, user_id). Upsert prevents dupes at the app layer but a unique compound index would harden against race conditions on concurrent POSTs. Non-blocking.
Minor — list_acknowledgments returns docs with .to_list(500) and excludes _id; safe for JSON. Could add sort by acknowledged_at desc for nicer UX. Non-blocking.
server.py still 1539 lines after iter-6 split; this iteration added ~120 lines for the new endpoints. Acceptable, but onboarding/documents could be moved into routers/ in a follow-up.
